name: Midara ni Messatsu! Momoiro Kunoichi Ninpouchou♪ ~Ryoukan Shogun no Inbou!?~
original_name: 淫らに滅殺！桃色くノ一忍法帖♪ ～陵姦将軍の淫棒!?～
source:
* The splendid ninja sisters are back! Take out General F**k! * 

Several years passed since the great battles of Enchanted Splendor. 
Kazumi and Yuuha's daughters Momoka and Hazuki had completed their 
disciplinary training and joined a respectable shogunate. 

Amid the welcoming celebrations, their shogun general's cherished 
daughter Sakurahime was kidnapped was kidnapped by the 
vile General Ryokan ("General F**k") of the spirit realm. 

Momoka and Hazuki are charged with the safe recovery of Sakurahime. 
To do this, they have to traverse the r*pe-loving land of erotic yokai! 

What fate awaits...?! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE099745.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
华丽的忍者姐妹回归了！击败陵奸将军！

自华之战役以来已过去数年。和美和枫叶的女儿桃花和叶月完成了修行训练，加入了一个受人尊敬的幕府。在欢迎庆典期间，幕府将军的珍爱女儿樱姬被灵界的邪恶将军陵奸（“操逼将军”）绑架了。桃花和叶月被指派安全救回樱姬。为此，她们必须穿越热爱强奸的色情妖怪领地！

怎样的命运在等待着……！？

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE099745.html]DLsite English[/url]]
